cases.sentence: На севере будет надел у Дана; его граница протянется по ___ до Лево-Хамата, и далее до Гацар-Енана, что на границе с Дамаском, на севере от Хамата.
cases.explain: «Хетлонской дороге» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

cases.sentence: На границе с владениями Иуды с востока на запад будет ___ 25 000 локтей в ширину, равный по длине с востока на запад родовому наделу.
cases.explain: «особый участок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

cases.explain: «Особый участок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

cases.translation: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

cases.sentence: Надел будет принадлежать посвященным священникам из клана Цадока, которые верно служили Мне и не отступили, как левиты, с ___.

cases.translation: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

cases.sentence: Он будет принадлежать им, как ___ из священного надела, великая святыня на границе с участком левитов.
cases.explain: «особая земля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
